input.free_text_description: This system is a file management platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user, ftp download param, ftp upload param. The platform provides capabilities for user. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage ftp download param records, so that I can track and organize ftp download param data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage ftp upload param records, so that I can track and organize ftp upload param data effectively.
As an Admin, I want to view reports and analytics, so that I can make informed business decisions.
